_comment: The hand-written half. Edit this daily; fetch-data.mjs merges it with FRED and never overwrites it.
summary: Attacks continue with Iran, keeping the Strait of Hormuz closed. Simple fix: use our oil reserves to bring oil prices down, right? We have been, but the disruption is too large, about a fifth of oil supply. Even better, Saudi Arabia's east-west pipeline has been avoiding this disruption by funneling oil underground and around the strait closure. Well, it got attacked recently, and now it's closed as well. Some numbers to put it into context (strait closure = 20% of global oil supply, pipeline closure = 5% of global supply). CPI report was released, core YoY fell, but MoM has been increasing, especially in August +0.3%. Pretty BAD. Basically means other factors are affecting inflation, not just the oil disruption. Job market is strong, Wall Street estimated 58,000, came in at 162,000. The economy is too hot. Warsh might (should) hike. Bessent's hands are tied, trying to conduct monetary policy with a fiscal toolbox. Buybacks aren't working. Other countries are selling their US bonds, no bueno. To add a cherry on top, our largest debt holder Japan now has more incentive to invest at home, due to its CB hikes. Bringing it back home, the President and VP don't want to raise rates. Every single factor is saying we NEED to raise rates, Warsh and Bessent know this. Only thing I'll say, grab your popcorn for Sep 16, the day that decision is made.

news.what: 10 year hit 5% for the first time since 2023. The other time it hit that was in 2007...
Anthropic CEO just said we need to slow down the AI race. Take a second to think about that.
CPI report → headline MoM came in hotter than expected (also core).
Houthi attacks on shipping sent Brent to about $108.
Payrolls +162,000 vs 58,000 expected → interesting breakdown, a loss in tech jobs.
Waller: no hike vote unless conditions change. Vance calls for a cut. GPT-6 Astra released.

_fed_note: lastMove 0 means the FOMC held. Use -0.25 / +0.25 only for an actual move. Hand-entered - nothing validates this.
_oil_note: Optional daily override. Set asOf to the date you read them and fill wti/brent. Used only while newer than FRED's print - if you stop updating, it falls back to FRED automatically rather than showing an ever-staler number.
_curve_note: Optional hand entry for a yield FRED has not published yet. Same rule as oil: only used while newer than FRED. notes/alert are display only. Put alert on whatever the day's story is: it turns the figure rust and is the only thing telling a first-time visitor where to look.
